digest.description: F5 (context-footprint plan): true serves records_digest — per-record metadata (ts, block, attestor, response sha12 + length, resolved key names) with the record BODIES omitted (records comes back empty). The chain-coherence preflight scan needs ordering + identity + counts, never the prose; pass false (the default) only when a record's full text is actually needed — the branchpoint rule.
